facts.fact: Pavi tried the drain grate at noon before Neela's party arrived to reach the flask in the store; it was pinned again and two hunters sat on it.
Neela's flask is in the store inside the Resin House wall; Neela has no bad ankle, only the ache.
Devan sends Pavi and the five Kettamala men from the sheds east with Bhaskaran's party.
